record.original_question: For every coprime pair of positive integers a and b and every d, prove e-positivity of h_hat_d^(a,b)(x;q,1+r), meaning that its expansion in the elementary symmetric-function basis has coefficients in N[q,r]. Also, for every pair j,k with j+k=d-1, prove the e-inclusion q s_hat_(j+1|k-1)^(a,b)(x;q,1+r) <=_e s_hat_(j|k)^(a,b)(x;q,1+r), meaning that the difference expands in the elementary basis with coefficients in N[q,r].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Work in the ring of symmetric functions in variables $x = (x_1, x_2, \dots)$ over $\mathbb{Q}(q,t)$. Let $\{e_\lambda\}$ denote the elementary symmetric function basis. For a coprime pair of positive integers $(a,b)$ and a nonnegative integer $d$, there are distinguished symmetric functions (arising from operators in the elliptic Hall algebra acting on $1$)
\[ \hat h_d^{(a,b)}(x;q,t) \quad\text{and, for } j+k=d-1,\ \hat s_{(j\,|\,k)}^{(a,b)}(x;q,t), \]
which are symmetric functions with coefficients in $\mathbb{Q}(q,t)$. (These are the rectangular-Catalan analogues of the hook/Schur-indexed images under the iterated higher operators; here $(j\,|\,k)$ denotes the hook shape with arm $j$ and leg $k$.)

For symmetric functions $F,G$ with coefficients in $\mathbb{N}[q,r]$ when expanded in the $e$-basis, write $F \le_e G$ to mean that $G-F$ has all $e$-expansion coefficients in $\mathbb{N}[q,r]$. Call $F$ "$e$-positive in $(q,r)$" if its $e$-coefficients lie in $\mathbb{N}[q,r]$.

Problem. Substitute $t = 1+r$ and prove the following two statements.

(i) ($e$-positivity.) For every coprime pair $(a,b)$ of positive integers and every $d \ge 0$,
\[ \hat h_d^{(a,b)}(x;q,1+r) \text{ is } e\text{-positive in } (q,r); \]
that is, its expansion in the basis $\{e_\lambda\}$ has all coefficients in $\mathbb{N}[q,r]$.

(ii) ($e$-inclusion.) For every coprime pair $(a,b)$, every $d\ge 1$, and every pair of nonnegative integers $j,k$ with $j+k=d-1$,
\[ q\,\hat s_{(j+1\,|\,k-1)}^{(a,b)}(x;q,1+r) \ \le_e\ \hat s_{(j\,|\,k)}^{(a,b)}(x;q,1+r), \]
i.e. the difference $\hat s_{(j\,|\,k)}^{(a,b)}(x;q,1+r) - q\,\hat s_{(j+1\,|\,k-1)}^{(a,b)}(x;q,1+r)$ expands in the elementary basis with coefficients in $\mathbb{N}[q,r]$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is part of a list of open positivity/inclusion conjectures concerning operators arising from rectangular Catalan combinatorics and the elliptic Hall algebra. Subsequent surveys (e.g. the 2021 survey on Symmetric Functions and Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics) reiterate these as conjectures with supporting evidence, and no proof of e-positivity at t=1+r in this generality appears in the literature. The status is reported as open.

status_evidence.title: Open Questions for operators related to Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: Formulates open questions on Schur and e-positivity/inclusion for symmetric functions arising from elliptic Hall algebra operators.
status_evidence.claim: The e-positivity/e-inclusion at t=1+r is stated as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Symmetric Functions and Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics (2021 survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey presenting Macdonald operators, rectangular Catalan combinatorics, and positivity conjectures, restating these as conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: More recent survey continues to list these positivity questions as open.
